PAIRS.label: I · The Magician
PAIRS.why: the first card, the new save's pair: the tools laid on the table

special.label: Hooked Shot
special.line: A shot that drags what it hits to you.

PAIRS.label: II · The High Priestess
PAIRS.why: the scroll and the veil: what is hidden, read

special.label: Revelation
special.line: The Flash and the dowse at once: every hidden signature near you shown and tagged.

PAIRS.label: III · The Empress
PAIRS.why: what the coffin draws in, the brush gives back: abundance

special.label: Coffin's Mop
special.line: The coffin drinks spilled paint and crude as it passes, and the brush pours it back as paint.

PAIRS.label: IV · The Emperor
PAIRS.why: the beat commands and the gun keeps it: order

special.label: On the Beat
special.line: Six shots fired on the bell's beat, each one staggering.

PAIRS.label: V · The Hierophant
PAIRS.why: bell and book: the rite, the teaching

special.label: Rite
special.line: A toll that reads every creature it reaches, knowing it better.

PAIRS.label: VI · The Lovers
PAIRS.why: the blade and the bell in time: a duet

special.label: Rung Line
special.line: Hook a creature and the toll runs down the line, stunning it.

PAIRS.label: VII · The Chariot
PAIRS.why: the hook and the vane: travel, two forces held in one hand

special.label: Slingshot
special.line: Throw the fork far and hook to it, flung through the air.

PAIRS.label: VIII · Strength
PAIRS.why: the edge tamed by the soft brush: gentle force

special.label: Gentle Edge
special.line: A cutlass string whose blows calm instead of hurt.

PAIRS.label: IX · The Hermit
PAIRS.why: the scholar's desk: study alone, by lantern

special.label: Illumined Page
special.line: Photograph a sigil and it is written on what you photographed.

PAIRS.label: X · The Wheel of Fortune
PAIRS.why: the wheel of odds and the turning weather

special.label: Turn of Weather
special.line: Spin the wheel of odds to turn the weather where you stand for a game hour.

PAIRS.label: XI · Justice
PAIRS.why: the sword and the scales: the blade and the appraisal

special.label: Appraised Cut
special.line: A blow on a weak point you have photographed is always the right kind.

PAIRS.label: XII · The Hanged Man
PAIRS.why: a moment held: the plate and the coffin

special.label: Held Plate
special.line: A photograph holds a creature still in time for a moment.

PAIRS.label: XIII · Death
PAIRS.why: the blade and the coffin

special.label: Reaper's Draw
special.line: A blow that downs a creature drinks its Lachryma straight into the coffin.

PAIRS.label: XIV · Temperance
PAIRS.why: pouring between two cups: paint and song, the healing pair

special.label: Healing Song
special.line: Paint laid on the beat mends your cracks.

PAIRS.label: XV · The Devil
PAIRS.why: the chain

special.label: Chain Shot
special.line: A shot that chains two creatures together where they stand.

PAIRS.label: XVI · The Tower
PAIRS.why: the bolt from the sky

special.label: Lightning Rod
special.line: Where the fork sticks, a bolt comes down.

PAIRS.label: XVII · The Star
PAIRS.why: water poured on land and pool: the painted lure

special.label: Painted Lure
special.line: The lure thrown leaves a stream of paint behind it.

PAIRS.label: XVIII · The Moon
PAIRS.why: the mirage under the sky: illusion

special.label: Singing Mirage
special.line: A decoy rises where the fork lands, singing so creatures go to it.

PAIRS.label: XIX · The Sun
PAIRS.why: the flash and the shutter: all shown

special.label: The Mark
special.line: The Flash marks a creature, and every chamber homes on the mark.

PAIRS.label: XX · Judgement
PAIRS.why: the trumpet opens the coffin

special.label: Last Call
special.line: The toll opens the coffin: all it drank bursts out as a wave.

PAIRS.label: XXI · The World
PAIRS.why: the first tool and the mending one: the circle closed

special.label: Full Circle
special.line: A shot that paints where it lands and mends what it passes.
